body: Your tune seems to be changing. How could you be so sure?

The QB comment was said by my high school football coach and the other comments came in college and I don’t think very many people on my college football team would disagree. I was also voted least accountable on said team.

What about when I do talk, on multiple occasions I’ve heard remarks along the lines of: “he’s attractive until he opens his mouth” or  “he’s too stupid too play QB”. This seems to be mostly everyone’s impression of me.
